title: 第二十二章    苏林依的疑惑
content_zh:
“哦？为什么？”孙依诗可知道这个世界上没有免费的午餐，更没有免费的vip，看这个中年经理一脸笑眯眯的样子，总觉得那双眼睛里面有些闪烁。

    被问到的经理有些尴尬，但并没有支支吾吾的，反而镇定下来落落大方的说道：“相遇就是缘分，既然苏小姐和孙小姐今日大驾光临，我作为这里的经理自然是要好好招待的。”

    仅仅是这一句话，苏林依和孙依诗就明白这是怎么一回事儿了，虽然没有见过这个经理，但是这个经理竟然上赶着讨好她们，说是没有事情相求那纯属是开玩笑。

    而孙依诗和苏林依显然不是为了一顿饭就把自己给卖了的人。

    “还是不了，这里有这里的规矩，我们也不能坏了规矩不是？”一直都是古灵精怪能说会道的孙依诗来应付这些人，苏林依显然不适合这样的场合。

    陈木就冷眼旁观，如果没有安全问题的话他就冷冰冰的在那里站着，谁也不搭理。

    “孙小姐实在太客气了，我只是想和二位交个朋友，来，这边请。”那经理不由分说便指引着三人去了vip包厢，孙依诗向苏林依使了个眼色，她倒是要看看这个什么经理葫芦里到底卖的什么药。

    陈木一直很在后面，一言不发，倒是一直都在默默留意身边人的动向。

    “依依姐，他们家这几个菜都很好吃，我跟你讲哦，要是来这里不吃这些的话，那就真是亏大了！”孙依诗一本正经的说道，但是两眼放光的盯着菜单的样子已经暴露了她是一个吃货的事实。

    “好好好，小诗说的这些我都会尝尝的，对了，陈木你想吃些什么？”苏林依没有忘了一直都在一边充当背景板的陈木，贴心的问道。

    还没等陈木说什么，孙依诗倒是先说话了“诶呦诶呦，依依姐这是开始关心起木头了吗！啊啊啊啊，就说了你们要公开恋情了！”孙依诗边说边笑，虽然是玩笑话，但是听在苏林依耳朵里还是让她有些害羞。

    而陈木依旧不发表任何看法，只是看了看孙依诗，然后从苏林依的手里接过菜单，但在这过程中却不小心碰到了苏林依的手，陈木蓦然间感觉到了一种奇异的微弱电流通过，有些怪怪的。

    苏林依却是反应比较大。如同触电般的马上就收回了手。

    “这个，这个，还有这个，这个，都来一份。”陈木懒得一一念名字，直接对着服务员随便指了几个招牌菜，对于他这种曾经修炼到渡劫期的高手来说，口腹之欲早就没有了，吃东西也不过是因为现在修为不够不能辟谷而已。

    三个人点菜的场面因为有了孙依诗还是挺热闹的，但是被晾在一边的经理却有些尴尬。

    “二位小姐，这个……”经理看三人已经点完菜，便想趁着空挡说些什么，没想到孙依诗一下子就抓住了经理打算说的话，及时开口截下了。

    “经理难道是有什么事情想要和我们商量？还是说这办理vip的事情我们银货两讫？”孙依诗可不是个好对付的，虽然平时喜欢吵吵闹闹，但是鬼点子多的很，说起话来总能把人呛的哑口无言。

    “不不不，银货两讫可不好说，我确实有事情想和二位小姐商量，只是不知道这位能否回避一下？”经理看向一直坐在一旁一言不发的陈木，眼神示意想要让陈木回避。

    但是这绝对不可能，前一阵子苏林依还差点就遭到了绑架，陈木现在对于这两位大小姐的态度就是寸步不离，根本不可能因为这个什么狗屁经理的一句话就闪人不见。
content_en:
"Oh? Why?" Sun Yishi knew that there is no free lunch in this world, let alone free VIP. Looking at the smiling face of this middle-aged manager, she always felt that there was something twinkling in her eyes.

The manager who was asked was a little embarrassed, but he did not hesitate. Instead, he calmed down and said calmly and generously: "Meeting is fate. Since Miss Su and Miss Sun are here today, I, as the manager here, naturally have to entertain them well."

With just this sentence, Su Linyi and Sun Yishi understood what was going on. Although they had never met the manager, he was rushing to please them. It was just a joke to say that he had nothing to ask for.

And Sun Yishi and Su Linyi were obviously not people who sold themselves for a meal.

"It still doesn't work. There are rules here, and we can't break them, right?" Sun Yishi, who has always been quirky and eloquent, has always been the one to deal with these people. Su Linyi is obviously not suitable for such an occasion.

Chen Mu just watched with cold eyes. If there were no safety issues, he would just stand there coldly and ignore anyone.

"Miss Sun is so polite. I just want to make friends with you two. Come on, please come over here." The manager couldn't help but guide the three of them to the VIP box. Sun Yishi winked at Su Linyi. She wanted to see what kind of medicine this manager was selling.

Chen Mu stayed behind and said nothing, but he was always paying attention to the movements of the people around him.

"Sister Yiyi, these dishes at their house are all delicious. Let me tell you, it would be a big loss if you don't eat these when you come here!" Sun Yishi said seriously, but the way she stared at the menu with bright eyes revealed the fact that she is a foodie.

"Okay, okay, I will try what Xiaoshi said. By the way, Chen Mu, what do you want to eat?" Su Linyi asked thoughtfully without forgetting Chen Mu who was always acting as a backdrop.

Before Chen Mu could say anything, Sun Yishi spoke first, "Hey yo yo, sister Yiyi is starting to care about Mu Mu! Ahhhhh, I told you that you were going to make your relationship public!" Sun Yishi laughed as she spoke. Although it was a joke, it still made her a little shy in Su Linyi's ears.

Chen Mu still didn't express any opinion. He just looked at Sun Yishi, and then took the menu from Su Linyi's hand. However, in the process, he accidentally touched Su Linyi's hand. Chen Mu suddenly felt a strange weak current passing through, which was a bit weird.

Su Linyi had a bigger reaction.He immediately withdrew his hand as if he was electrocuted.

"This, this, and this, this, have some." Chen Mu didn't bother to read the names one by one, and pointed out a few signature dishes to the waiter. For a master like him who had practiced to the tribulation stage, the appetite for food has long been gone, and eating is just because he is not strong enough now and cannot live without food.

The scene of three people ordering food was quite lively because of Sun Yishi, but the manager who was left alone felt a little embarrassed.

"You two ladies, this..." The manager saw that the three of them had finished ordering, and wanted to say something during the break. Unexpectedly, Sun Yishi immediately caught what the manager was going to say and intercepted it in time.

"Does the manager want to discuss something with us? Or do we have to settle the VIP matter?" Sun Yishi is not easy to deal with. Although she usually likes to make noises, she has a lot of clever ideas and can always make people speechless when she talks.

"No, no, no, it's hard to tell when the money is settled. I do have something to discuss with the two ladies, but I don't know if this person can avoid it?" The manager looked at Chen Mu, who had been sitting aside and said nothing, and his eyes indicated that he wanted Chen Mu to avoid it.

But this is absolutely impossible. Su Linyi was almost kidnapped a while ago. Chen Mu's attitude towards these two eldest ladies is that they will never leave each other. It is impossible to disappear just because of a word from this bullshit manager.
